About me

At RBC I built tools to make it easier to look after hundreds of banking apps. At Magna I wrote software that automated safety analysis for automotive engineers.

Outside of work, I’ve built robots, worked on a high-altitude radio payload, and designed a keyboard down to its PCB and firmware.
